context.brief: Current existing functional level-I barracks is a solid orange wedge. Keep the exact tent footprint, height and all poles/supplies/bench. Remodel ONLY cloth shell and ropes: curved taut roof with visible seams, actual open entrance with folded side flaps, sagging awning. Prefer restrained blue/sand cloth coherent with current Bastion; no castle replacement, new props or crowd. No closed fake black doorway. Preserve library source and gameplay parcel. Select a coherent full geometric treatment from the typed operations and values below, explain silhouette and material choices. No scores or approval.
